question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 1 to 6 represented as dots. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aedec1fdb82f7fcaca7c8ce420c9c61d9b9c81b612a40f569b372556839f75a.png]
solution:
From the given two dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a022162fcbcebfbda88b100d7c83767dbf21d0c623c127faf57616a995c65367.png] 

→ 3 and 1 are common surface in both Dice, therefore, '4' is the opposite surface of '5'.

Here, '4' is opposite to the face containing '5'.

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
